title: Mass Assignment - Service Active Status Manipulation via POST /api/v1/services
description: The POST /api/v1/services endpoint in the vulnerable API accepts an 'active' field in the request body through the createServiceSchema Zod schema. The schema includes 'active: z.boolean().optional()'. The handler passes the entire parsed data (including active) to the CreateService use case. This allows a BARBER (who has access to this endpoint) to create services with active=false, making them invisible to customers but still existing in the system.
impact: Service visibility manipulation. A BARBER can create hidden services (active=false) that are not visible to customers but exist in the system. This could be used to hide services, manipulate pricing visibility, or create shadow services for internal use. While less severe than role escalation, it allows business logic manipulation.
mitigation: 1) Remove 'active' field from createServiceSchema in vulnerable API (secure API already excludes it). 2) The CreateService use case should default active to true and not accept it as input. 3. The domain's createService function already defaults active to true - the API should not override this.
